## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 421 captures during December 2025. This represents the site’s reported activity for the month. The activity count provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes across the service. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 421 captures, 16 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.8 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from images that produced a grading outcome. The image-quality results should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations.

## Grading

The site recorded 133 referable results during December 2025. The median grading lag was 2 days. This indicates the central point in the distribution of grading waits for the month. Together, the referable total and the median lag provide the main grading measures for the reporting period. Overall, the report records the activity completed, the proportion of captures that could not be graded, and the timeliness of grading at Harbour Eye Clinic.
